about: The WOOF-NAM suite: the NAM 12 km parent and the five nests NCEP ran beside it (nam.v4.2.11 scripts/exnam_fcst.sh, tm00 branch), as data. `woof-nam suite` (namgpu/suite) reads this table; a new nest or another card layout is a row here, never code. Sources: NAM v4.2.11 parm/nam_configfile_* (dimensions, steps, radiation, blending rows), parm/nam_namelist.nps_* (centres), ush/nam_prdgen_nest.sh (product grids), and NOAA's last cycle 2026-11-03 06Z (file names, record counts). has the citations.

product_grid.computed: nam_firewx_gridspecs: the bounding box of the nest's corners on the 1.27 km CONUS Lambert master (4289 x 2753, La1 20.192, Lo1 -121.554, LoV -95, Latin 25) or the 1.488 km Alaska polar-stereographic master (3297 x 2209, La1 40.530, Lo1 -178.571, LoV -150, 100 points of padding)

declared: Every nest is one-way from our own 12 km parent history (boundaries every 3 h), started after the parent has written the nest's hours; NCEP ran the nests one-way concurrent inside one executable, boundaries every parent step.

The fire-weather nest takes its start and boundaries from the 12 km parent (space ratio 8); NCEP's was a ratio-2 child of the CONUS (or Alaska) 3 km nest. The point, size, spacing and length are NCEP's.
Each nest sits on its own rotated pole at NCEP's centre with NCEP's point counts and spacing (woof-nam nest); NCEP's nests share the parent's pole.

layouts._doc: card -> domains, by the box's card count. A domain on several cards runs `woof-nam nest --cards N`; domains listed on one card share it (each checks its memory before it starts and waits for room). The parent (12km) runs on one card: its hand-off set is one-card only (io_history_fields.handoff_fields). On 8 cards the three small nests share card 7 (measured peaks 16.2, 13.4 and 12.5 GiB of the 96) and the parent keeps card 0 to itself: with the fire-weather nest on card 0 from the parent's hour 36 the parent went from 272 to about 380 ms/step, and every 3 km nest waits for the parent's hour 60 (proof cycle 2026-11-03 06Z). On 4 cards the CONUS nest runs on all four (4 x RTX PRO 6000, 2026-11-10: 63-68 s per forecast hour, 18.3-18.6 GiB per rank in the step loop, 59.4 GiB on card 0 during its init-save; on cards 1-2 alone it was estimated at 110-145 s per hour). The other nests go where the CONUS rank leaves about 67 GiB free, and none on card 0: card 0 also holds the parent and the CONUS GRIB2 follower, and every CONUS rank waits on the slowest one (hours 4-6 ran 4-32 % slower when the follower shared card 0 with rank 0).
